tiers.category: The bank declined the card. Check the card details and the available funds, or try another card.
tiers.never_tell: The payment could not be authorised. Contact your bank or use another payment method. A human agent can look into it.

3D Not Authenticated.text: The bank's identity check (3D Secure, for example a code or app approval) was not completed.

Issuer Unavailable.text: The card issuer's system could not be reached at the time. This is usually temporary.

Shopper Cancelled.text: The payment was cancelled before it was completed.
